descriptions.text: Agility is a basic attribute available to all Avatars. It influences almost every action where coordination, finesse, and grace are involved.

Agility is a basic attribute available to all Avatars. It influences almost every action where coordination, finesse and grace are involved. Agility is defined as being characterized by quickness, lightness, and ease of movement, both physically and mentally. Agility is a very important skill in PE, because it influences the chance of an avatar avoiding mob (monster) hits entirely, rather than lessening the damage or providing more hit points for the mob to work through. It also makes you run faster. Agility is easily gained by being attacked by mobs. Professions: All

Professions: All This attribute is gained by the following skills: General: Athletics General: Coolness General: Courage General: Dexterity General: Perception General: Serendipity General: Bravado Combat: Combat Sense Combat: Commando Combat: Weapons Handling Medical: Anatomy This list is not complete yet.

Health is the amount of punishment your Avatar can sustain until he or she dies. Health is the attribute of being mentally, socially, and physically able to act and react to varying situations. In EU, health is one of the most obvious physical attributes and is very important to one's ability to be effective for two reasons. The first is that higher maximum health allows one to take a bigger hit without dying. The second is that in EU hitpoints are regenerated every 20 seconds, and 1/20th of the maximum health is regenerated each time. That means that for example with 200 health maximum an avatar gets 10 hp back every 20 seconds, while with 100 health it gets just 5. Hitpoints (health) are not gained in an integral fashion (not by +1 at a time). Each time an avatar gets a skill gain that influences health, a tiny fraction of a hit point is gained, as well. A notice is given when the avatar hit points reach the next integer value. This makes it difficult to know how much any specific skill affects health without chipping that skill in or out, because when an avatar skills multiple skills, many of them may be contributing to the health increase at a time. Professions: All This attribute is gained most quickly by the following skills: General: Athletics General: Coolness General: Courage General: Dexterity General: Perception General: Serendipity Combat: Combat Sense Combat: Commando Combat: Weapons Handling This list is not complete yet.
